title.tagline: Party chaos for 2-8 friends on one laptop
title.hint: Arrows + ENTER to choose   |   ESC = back
title.secret: SECRET FOUND: Durian joined the party!

join.title: WHO'S PLAYING?
join.need2: Need 2+ players (press + to add a bot)
join.ghost: Ghosting test: everyone hold your keys. Unlit key = keyboard can't handle that combo, try a gamepad.
join.lan: LAN: on phones/laptops open {url} and tap A to join

settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.bad: That file isn't a KACAU! save
settings.hint: Arrows = move   ENTER / click = change   ESC = back

free.title: FREE PICK
free.hint: Pick any mini-game to practise. ESC = back

sumo.name: Belly Bump Sumo
sumo.desc: Your arrow spins. Press to DASH. Bump everyone out of the ring!

quickdraw.name: Wait For It...
quickdraw.desc: Slam your button when it says GO! Too early = OOPS. Watch for fakes!

noodle.name: Tangled Noodles
noodle.desc: Steer your noodle. Don't crash into any noodle or the wall!

sack.name: Balap Karung
sack.desc: Sack race! Press your two keys one after the other (A, B, A, B) to hop. Same key twice = faceplant!

kerupuk.name: Makan Kerupuk
kerupuk.desc: Hands behind your back! Bite your swinging cracker when it's right at your mouth. Miss = CHOMP air.

potato.name: Hot Potato Bomb
potato.desc: Got the bomb? Throw it LEFT or RIGHT before it goes BOOM. Last one standing wins!

colorsnap.name: Colour Snap
colorsnap.desc: Press ONLY when the big blob shows YOUR colour and shape. Gold star = everyone! Wrong press = -1.

tug.name: Tarik Tambang
tug.desc: Tug of war, two teams! Mash to pull. Pull on the drum beat for DOUBLE power.
tug.final: FINAL PULL! Every pull counts more!

sweeper.name: Spin Sweeper
sweeper.desc: A giant beam spins around. Press to JUMP over it. Get swept = out!

hoops.name: Floppy Hoops
hoops.desc: Press to jump toward the ball. Holding it? Press again in the air to SHOOT. Best at the top of your jump!

pancake.name: Pancake Panic
pancake.desc: Press to flip your pancake. It must land FLAT in the pan. Most good flips wins!

plane.name: Paper Plane
plane.desc: Press once to lock the ANGLE, again to lock the POWER. Furthest of 2 throws wins.

drums.name: Drum Battle
drums.desc: Hit your drum when a note reaches the line. Perfect timing = big points, keep the combo!

tiles.name: Crumble Tiles
tiles.desc: Your arrow spins. Press to HOP one tile that way. Cracked tiles fall. Don't fall!

stack.name: Tower Stack
stack.desc: Press to drop the sliding block. Overhang gets chopped off. Tallest tower wins!

panjat.name: Panjat Pinang
panjat.desc: Team pole climb! Alternate A and B to climb. Same key twice = slide down. Grab the prizes first!

balloon.name: Balloon Pump
balloon.desc: Pump your balloon (A), then tie it off (B) before it POPS. Biggest balloon wins!
balloon.hint: A = PUMP    B = TIE IT OFF (keep it)

coconut.name: Coconut Rain
coconut.desc: Move left and right to dodge falling coconuts. Bonk = out!

holdit.name: Hold It!
holdit.desc: Hold your key and let go at exactly 5.00 seconds. The clock disappears after 2 seconds!

curling.name: Ice Curling
curling.desc: When it's your turn, press to slide your stone. Closest to the bullseye wins. Bump others away!

kelereng.name: Marble Spoon Race
kelereng.desc: HOLD to walk with a marble on your spoon. Too fast = it wobbles off! Let go to steady it.

bakiak.name: Bakiak Team Walk
bakiak.desc: Your team shares giant wooden clogs. Everyone presses the foot on the sign, then you step. Wrong foot = everybody trips!

paku.name: Nail in the Bottle
paku.desc: A nail swings from a string on your back. HOLD to lower it and drop it into the bottle when it's right above. Most nails wins!

jumprope.name: Jump Rope
jumprope.desc: Jump when the rope hits your feet. It keeps getting faster! Last one jumping wins.

lava.name: Rising Lava
lava.desc: Ledges slide left and right. Jump to the next one up when it's above you. Miss = drop down. Don't touch the lava!

log.name: Spinning Log
log.desc: Balance on a rolling log over the mud. Lean against the spin! It changes direction. Last one standing wins.

volley.name: Giant Volleyball
volley.desc: Team game. Run under the HUGE ball and bonk it over the net with your head. Don't let it land on your side!

football.name: Wobbly Football
football.desc: Team game. Your arrow spins: press to DASH and bump the ball into the other team's goal.

chicken.name: Chicken Chase
chicken.desc: Whoever wears the chicken hat earns points. Everyone else: DASH into them to steal it! Most points wins.

bigger.name: More or Less?
bigger.desc: Which pile has MORE snacks? A = left, B = right. First right answer scores, a wrong one costs a point.

patung.name: Statue!
patung.desc: Music on: MASH to dance and score. Music off: FREEZE! Press in the silence and you lose a third of your points.

layangan.name: Layangan
layangan.desc: Hold A to pull your kite up, let go to let it sink. Keep it inside the golden wind! Most seconds in the wind wins.
layangan.hint: HOLD A = UP    LET GO = DOWN

gasing.name: Gasing Spin
gasing.desc: Alternate A and B fast to wind up your spinning top. Then steer it (A left, B right) and bump the others. Last top spinning wins!
gasing.wind: WIND IT UP! A B A B
gasing.hint: A = LEFT   B = RIGHT   bump the weak tops!

egg.name: Egg Catch
egg.desc: Move your basket (A left, B right). White egg +1, golden egg +3, rotten green egg -2!

chairs.name: Kursi Musik
chairs.desc: Walk while the music plays. When it STOPS, press A to grab a chair. One chair too few! Press during the music and you trip.

simon.name: Copy Me!
simon.desc: Watch the pattern of A and B, then press it back. One mistake and you are out. It gets longer every round!

fishing.name: Mancing
fishing.desc: Wait for the big BITE (!) then press A fast. Little nibbles are fake: press on a nibble and the fish swims away. Heaviest catch wins!
fishing.hint: Wait for the  !  then press A

parachute.name: Parachute Panic
parachute.desc: You are falling! Press A to open your parachute. The later you open it, the more points... too late = SPLAT. 3 jumps.

bridge.name: Glass Bridge
bridge.desc: Each row: LEFT tile (A) or RIGHT tile (B). One is fake! Everybody sees broken tiles, so wait and learn... but the clock is ticking.

sepeda.name: Sepeda Lambat
sepeda.desc: Slow bike race: tap A to pedal. The SLOWEST rider wins! Too slow and you wobble and fall. Cross the finish line and you lose.

party.title: PARTY MODE
party.intro: Roll, collect coins, buy STARS ({cost} coins). Most stars after {n} turns wins!
party.lastTurns: FINAL STRETCH! Board coins are DOUBLED!

events.chicken: A chicken steals 10 coins from the richest player and gives them to {name}!
events.chickenSelf: The chicken steals 10 coins from {name} (too rich!) and gives them to the poorest!
events.thief: STAR THIEF! {name} steals a star from {victim}!
events.thiefNone: Star thief found no stars... +10 coins instead
events.clown: HONK HONK! {name} drops half their coins!
events.charity: Charity day! {name} gives 2 coins to everyone
events.sale: STAR SALE! Stars cost half this turn!
events.blackout: BLACKOUT! In the dark, {name} picks up everyone's dropped coins!

wheel.star: FERRIS WHEEL: dropped off near the star!

party.saleOn: STAR SALE: half price this turn!

shop.title: UNLOCKS
shop.hint: Earn coins by playing. ENTER = buy, ESC = back

daily.title: DAILY CHAOS {d}
daily.info: Today's 5 games, every one with crazy modifiers. Same for everyone today!
